description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing APIService resources in the Kubernetes API aggregator client, including methods for create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, and apply operations.

classes.name: APIServicesGetter
classes.description: Interface for retrieving APIService interface implementations.

classes.name: APIServiceInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods to manage APIService resources.

classes.name: aPIServices
classes.description: Concrete implementation of APIServiceInterface using a generic client.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of an APIService.

methods.name: DeleteCollection
methods.description: Deletes a collection of APIService resources.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists APIService resources based on list options.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches for changes to APIService resources.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to an APIService.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a configuration to create or update an APIService.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a configuration to update the status of an APIService.
